{{Top|leg}}
'''Rendric''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was one of the first to discover that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was flooding the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] with [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]]. Rendric suggested in comments on "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]" that enterprising individuals might use [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to capture units, and mentioned that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] was paying bounties for captured Vipers.
